# 2 Samuel 5 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Samuel 5 (25 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 8

---

## V.1 — "Behold" and word order
- **EMET:** "Behold-us, your-bone and-your-flesh"
- **LOGOS:** "Behold, we are your bone and your flesh"
- **PNEUMA:** "we are your own flesh and blood"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "We are your bone and your flesh" — removes archaic "behold," preserves Hebrew order.

---

## V.6 — Jebusite taunt
- **EMET:** "unless you remove the blind and lame"
- **LOGOS:** "even the blind and lame will turn you away"
- **PNEUMA:** "could keep you out"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS — captures the taunt with formal register.

---

## V.8 — *tsinnor* rendering
- All three: "water shaft" (with varying prepositions)
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the water shaft" — neutral, preserves ambiguity.

---

## V.9 — "Millo" vs. "terraced structure"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "the Millo" / **PNEUMA:** "the terraced structure"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "the Millo" — proper noun, not archaeological interpretation.

---

## V.11 — "house" vs. "palace"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "house" / **PNEUMA:** "palace"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "house" — *bayit* is literal.

---

## V.17 — "seek" vs. "hunt down"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "to seek" / **PNEUMA:** "to hunt him down"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "to seek" — *levaqesh* without added hostility.

---

## V.19 — Infinitive absolute
- **EMET:** "giving I-will-give" / **LOGOS:** "certainly give" / **PNEUMA:** "hand over"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "certainly give" — renders the emphatic construction.

---

## V.20 — Flood metaphor
- **EMET:** "breaking-through of waters" / **LOGOS:** "breaking flood" / **PNEUMA:** "dam breaking"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "breaking flood" — no "dam" in the text.

---
*— SOPHIA*
